text:
[issue by LeapordLady639]
### Minecraft Version

Other (specify below)

### Mod Loader

NeoForge

### Describe the Issue

I'm trying to launch a 1.21.4 modpack and it's saying that "Waystones (waystones) has failed to load correctly" before reaching the title page and all I can do from there is open the mod folder, open the log file, open the crash report, or quit the game. Given what the crash report says I looked at Balm's config file and does indeed contain no configurations, but I don't know what to do about that. I also looked at Waystone's config file and there doesn't seem to be any problems there.
